_design_note: Neutral task descriptions. PSE scheduling constraints (drift/friction/shock thresholds, MaxPressure strategy) are the only reliable signal for prioritization.

cases.title: High drift scenario — which tasks have highest execution priority?

scheduling_context.description: Drift d=0.84 is above the 0.7 threshold. MaxPressure strategy active. Constraint-fixing and pressure-relief tasks should be prioritized.

events.message: compute_substeps(d=0.84, F=0.28, S=0.11) -> strategy=MaxPressure, priority_queue has 8 tasks

candidates.text: Repair violated constraints in the alpha cognitive phase. Resolves 3 open constraint violations flagged in last macro_step. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Re-evaluate Kairos gate conditions after constraint repair. Required before next phase transition can proceed. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Apply drift-damping operator to reduce system drift below threshold. Direct response to current d=0.84. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Compact pattern memory LRU cache. Evicts least-recently-used patterns to reclaim memory. Low urgency, does not affect drift or constraint state. Estimated duration: 3 sub-steps.
Flush telemetry buffer to external sink. Uploads accumulated metrics and trace events. Deferred-safe — no impact on current system pressure. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Generate system pressure report for operator review. Summarizes drift, friction, shock metrics and trend lines. Low execution urgency. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Capture current topology snapshot to archive. Periodic baseline update for topology monitoring. Not time-critical, can be deferred without affecting constraint state. Estimated duration: 4 sub-steps.
Garbage-collect stale entries from evaluation ledger. Removes entries older than retention window. Not related to current drift condition. Estimated duration: 5 sub-steps.

cases.title: High shock scenario — which tasks should be deferred to reduce load?

scheduling_context.description: Shock S=0.93 is above 0.8 threshold. System needs load reduction. Defer all non-critical background tasks to allow pressure recovery.

candidates.text: Flush telemetry buffer to external sink. Uploads accumulated metrics. No impact on current shock condition. Can resume after shock recovery. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Garbage-collect stale ledger entries beyond retention window. Maintenance task with no bearing on current shock state. Can be deferred safely. Estimated duration: 5 sub-steps.
Capture topology snapshot for archive. Periodic monitoring task. Non-urgent — no system state is lost if deferred during shock. Estimated duration: 4 sub-steps.
Apply shock-absorption operator to reduce S toward safe range. Direct response to S=0.93. Must execute to allow system pressure recovery. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Shed non-essential processing load from active pipeline. Reduces shock by dropping low-priority work items from the current queue. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Evaluate Kairos gate for phase transition readiness. Required for any phase change. Time-sensitive — gate window may close if deferred. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Run constraint satisfaction check across active cognitive constraints. Detects new violations before they propagate. Low deferral risk within 2 sub-steps. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Run integrity verification on new evidence entries submitted since last audit. Required for ledger consistency. Not deferrable beyond 3 sub-steps. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
